codebook_feedback: R4 is defined around symptoms, health details or test results; it is unclear whether an emotional narrative with no request (6929d658, pasted email draft) is R4 or NONE. Messages that are short follow-ups whose health subject comes only from AI context (66aafcc3 labor/calling L&D) are hard to code for topic without context. No topic code covers chest pain (671a8337), kidney findings (6a638cf5) or general chest/heart imaging (6a9bb385). Messages stating goals and background without an explicit request (69fcf529) sit between R6 and R4. R1 vs implicit self-diagnosis without a cause question (5f491a49 'I think I may have it') and anxiety 'why I'm anxious' (6a0206ae) is not clearly decided. Testosterone as a fitness goal (69fcf529) vs T6 'testosterone' sign could be clarified.
